run_latex2svg_cli: pipe LaTeX code from stdin to the latex2svg CLI and get SVG output on stdout
run_latex2svg_with_preamble: run the latex2svg CLI with a custom preamble file to render LaTeX math to SVG
call_latex2svg_function: call the latex2svg function with LaTeX code and params dict to get SVG data and dimensions
customize_latex2svg_params: customize the latex2svg default_params dict to change fontsize, template, or preamble before rendering
review_latex2svg_template: review the default_template and default_preamble variables to understand the LaTeX document structure used for rendering
